question: How many customers are there in each country? List the country and the count.
spider_source: EXAMPLE — replace with the Spider db_id + question index you adapted
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What are the titles of all albums by the artist 'AC/DC'?
spider_source: EXAMPLE — replace with the Spider db_id + question index you adapted
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'
